system.description: This paint job makes the vehicle less noticeable. It grants a +5 circumstance bonus on Bluff and @Check[skill:hide]{Hide check}s when tailing another vehicle or losing a tail. In addition, anyone wishing to break into the vehicle (other than the owner) must succeed at a @Check[save:will|dc:15]{Will save (DC 15)} or be unable to do so. This is a mind-affecting spell-like effect; a new save may be attempted after 24 hours have passed.
